contentList.content: You're one to talk, after how you've treated people.
But I'm not as naive as I once was. In fact, I've become someone quite different altogether.
Grotesque.
I never imagined we'd be standing toe to toe on this day, in this place.
All right, let me see what I have...
You must know I miss you dearly, Tara.
Kiss him.
*If anything, this is mercy.*
Of course, tell me all.
Thank you, Halsin.
Ambition. Courage. Hope. They all burn you in the end.

[A missive in Withers' hand, addressed to some unknown entity. Though you understand the alphabet, the script, and the words themselves, the meaning eludes you. You glean only the impression of dark sun in white sky, and an offer. Or perhaps a warning?]
What awaiteth thee is a mystery even to me. I cannot account for thee, adventurer... hero... friend. But I know thy story endeth not here.
The runes are the key! Cazador is using them to leech the spawns' power.
*The current plan: sneak in, grab a smith, and force him to repair or replace your heart so you can live outside Avernus.*
I fear you are engaged in a grand game of Lanceboard, young Wyll, and you are already four moves behind.
It's just an honour to hear the Lord of Song play such beautiful music.
Silly Vlaakith! What would one undying know about the dealing of death?
I'd love to.
Aly's Last Wishes
I find it hard to picture you as some sort of homesteader.
Take Selected
Thanking you. A tune-up would give this rustbox of mine a new lease on life.
Chain Lightning
You know me. Neck deep in devil guts and demon blood until I find a permanent way out.
Then I shall take courage from your example.
Provides the highest performance gain. Recommended for 8K gameplay only.
Take care, lordling. Boo allowed you to ascend in the hope it would make a hero of you. And heroes invite other heroes to their fanciful get-togethers.
Needle on Needle - Our Late Editor in His Own Words
*Mizora responds with knowing silence - and a wide smile.*
128 imps, 42 dretch, 6 balor, and one particularly feisty abyssal chicken.
I have been entrusted with the delivery of a letter, to be read by the one to whom I promised divinity.
My knees are a little stiff. Must be a storm coming.
And now for the telling of tales, yes?
Engine's fine. I'll make it through tonight, but tomorrow would be pushing it.
Better let these fuckers know I'm back. And this time, I'm not alone.
My first since the reconstruction began. We left quite a mess behind, but the city begins to look something like itself once more.
A dog-eared copy of the Baldur's Mouth Gazette.
Wizards have a penchant for unusual pets. A flying cat? Delightful. A menagerie of dinosaurs, on the other hand...
As did I... but somehow I feel like I no longer need to roam - that I have found something worthy laying roots for.
Wyrmway

Salutations!

I'm writing to request your help in a mysterious case that has arisen since our little Bhaalian bash a half-year ago. Regrettably, I've had to take the credit for dispelling the Bhaal cult (in your absence, you understand), and am working on routing the remaining Bhaalists from our fair city (with the newly promoted Blaze Devella Fountainhead in tow, of course). This has made me a target. A false document bringing my name into ill-repute has been made public - an alleged unpaid bar tab at the Elfsong. If you happen to be passing through with a bindle of coin, perhaps you can persuade management of my obvious innocence? Much obliged.

Investigator Valeria - Sleuth of Helm.

PS. Any advice on getting Bhaalist blood out of cloth? My hat's not been the same since the Murder Tribunal.
Ah, my greatest purpose, and greatest reward. Those children have been through more than fate had any right to cast at them, and yet they go on, as resilient as anything in nature.
I've been enjoying life. Throwing parties, making connections, slowly amassing power...
Wild Magic Barbarian
The world is so much worse for her being gone. There was no one like her.
What transpired was the Dark Lady's will. If time rolled back, I would do the same thing all over again, without hesitation... yet I am not without sympathy.
This is terrorism. I won't condone it.
Heroes possess hearts of all kinds.
Do you miss the sun?
Baldur's Mouth Gazette
You have made allies and friends. Remain in Faerûn.
*Vlaakith will call for your head and send the kith'raki. They will chase you to the ends of the many planes.*
Professor Gale Dekarios of Blackstaff Academy, at your service.
*The red dragon appears, poised to carry you to the True Heir. You will fight for githyanki liberation as a Warrior of the Comet.*

It's funny. I'm hungry in my body, but in my soul too. That woman has lived a long life - births, deaths, love, misfortune. And if she agrees, I'll be able to give her a dignified end, and remember it all in her honour.
It's been a charmed immortality so far. I'm enjoying myself immensely.
*As you think upon the resplendent deaths to come, Father sends a premonition of your red-radiant destiny.*
Who knew smiling and waving could be so much work?
Chilling Touch
I've been using my infernal powers in service of good, working to keep the Sword Coast safe.
I'll go take a look around - be back soon.
It is an ill-gotten prize - yet one I mustn't refuse.
Cut-Throat Leather Ensemble
To another century of peace in the Sword Coast.
Wulbren has a plan to break out, but he needs our help. The Warden confiscated their weapons, but anything that can break rock will do. Whatever we find, we need to pass it to him - discreetly.
It was on Faerûn that you learned how to be free. This is your home now.
Even then, you may not understand. As it is, you never will, because there are no words in my language or yours to explain such mysteries of the heart.
As expected, Lorroakan falls short of any true academic standard. To believe Dame Aylin dead, based on a single subjective account?
Glittering Slippers
I'm spinning my web. Power grows slowly, but I have nothing but time now.
Are you kidding? We look fantastic.
Whatever her game, I'm bound by her rules. My future'll never be fully my own.
Oh no, this is far more sophisticated. It has layers.

So, we should divvy up what we tell people about what we've been doing these past few months - I'd hate to be a bore that comes along and regurgitates the same story to someone moments after you've told them. Any ideas?
It sounds like praying to you might serve me better than worshipping my own god. As leader or your temple, perhaps...
What has become of the egg, Lae'zel? Has it hatched?
I was afforded a destiny of my own choosing. When he comes of age, it is only right I give Xan the same.
[1]KB
Speaking of your father, how is he holding up?
Owlbear Toy
Peace and quiet will still be there waiting once I've lived a little. Though don't get me wrong - I've got a little cottage with a garden and animals in mind already.
*Hoot!*
Postcard E
Sometimes. But I don't need the githzerai to fight for us - just with us, love.
Shocked Squirrel
Ah. A kiss as sweet as the first you ever gave me.
It was chaos - drow against drow, the clash of blades echoing throughout caverns, the feel of warm blood that I could not see...
Would you mind demolishing Bhaal's domain while you're at it? Just if you're passing through.
Tombstone
Discovered by Scratch
No. Not in this life, at least.
Vlaakith will not have your head today. But have it, she will.
I've grown to love Waterdeep. Though I confess at first I found it a bit... overly pleased with itself.
I told you I would, didn't I?
Hunter Ranger
- I will leave nothing behind but meat and shattered bone.
It isn't too late for you. Other gods have given up divinity. You could still come home. To me. To your mother. To everyone who loves you.
Hmm. I expected too much meat and wine might cause the blood to curdle like day-old milk.
Forget it, Karlach. You're not ready to work as a team.
When you put it like that, we could open a guest house.
Evil never lasts. Someone will stop you.
It is not for me to boast - it was a shared effort to reclaim the stones of Moonrise and Reithwin, and build something new. I am just lucky to be a part of it.
Official Guild Letter
Our lives are certainly a far cry from the one I once pictured. Even now, with the orb's fires quelled by Mystra at last, I scarcely dare believe it.
Draconic Sorcerer
A nautiloid? Fascinating. I have never set foot on one myself.
Like my father, she believes in the bow and the blade. But she's teaching the Fist a new lesson:
Better than I could've ever imagined.
I'm glad you two have each other - Hells, I'd be almost tempted to come along if you'd have me... perhaps if your adventures ever lead you out of Avernus permanently.
Now that's how you celebrate.
Only if you leave me feeling lightheaded.
I am - I've been getting to know my parents.
Bhaal Cult Resurgent Under New Leadership, Investigators Say
Gorion Mausoleum
You have fallen prey to its manipulation.
Oh, how right you are, and how wonderful it is. We've had too little time for pleasures like these.
I confess, I'm rarely at home in such cities. But the wilds outside the city are wonderful, as is coming home to you.
Potent Mist Form
And it looks like life at Lae'zel's side is suiting you...
Besides, the heat's been terrible for my complexion.
Contemplate the symbol of Lathander in your hand.
Unsaved Changes
Ah, a most welcome sight.
I suppose you're right. If things go poorly, this could be the last chance that anyone has to show some affection. Ever. Come here.
Perhaps I'm being hasty. Perhaps we should go our separate ways.
Scrubbed to an inch of its life, the barely visible bloodstains on this Harper garb suggest it has seen more than a few 'parties'.
Why, I feel better already.
Yet the threads of fate hath not been woven into their final tapestry.
Baldur's Mouth Gazette
Do you regret turning from Vlaakith and joining Karlach in the Hells?
Sorn Orlith
I accept mod.io's <LSTag Type="Hyperlink" Info="ModioPrivacy">Privacy Policy</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Hyperlink" Info="ModioToS">Terms of Use</LSTag>.
Classic Wood Frame
It is good to see you, Jenevelle. How do your parents fare?
*You are greeted as a saviour, a champion, a hero... but sometimes you feel like something else entirely. An adventurer, a traveller, a survivor.*
Ah, but the glory can be found in the telling. The children love tales of underdogs, facing odds most unlikely. They shall appreciate your story, trust me.
Achoo! Pardon me.
Indeed there is. And we're better placed than most to take it.
You didn't seem to be of that mind when we last slipped away together. You couldn't get enough of me, as I recall.
Father died when the Iron Throne was destroyed. I should talk to Mizora; maybe there's something she can do.
Nothing stands out, honestly. It's all been a flurry.
Something's nagging at me. Could be a trap. The sort Zariel likes to set.
I'm glad to hear. You deserve it, after all you've done.
It does! I was born for this.
Mousers? I'm going to pretend you didn't suggest that, sir. Else I might never forgive you.
Prove it - say 'Ugh, the latrine's overflowing again - watch your step'.
Wulbren wants nothing to do with us. We'll have to find another way to help the tieflings escape.
I don't understand why you're so kind to me.
Reach out to Lae'zel. Seek the warmth of her touch.
My heart aches for her. I should have gone to the stars.
How did you meet your end?
Thank you for notifying us. Your report will be reviewed by the moderation team.
Tara, we've been through this. I'm here to be part of your life with Gale, not take him away from you.
My people will be free!
Let's put that theory to the test. Repeat after me: 'With a little bit of spittle, chew your vittles, then play skittles'.
I've had to do far worse things with my hands, trust me. This is no burden at all. I don't think I've ever slept more soundly than I have with my menagerie of beasts for company.
Tell me - I'm listening.
Regale Halsin with tales of your past six months.
I can slaughter legions of beasts down there and there's always another one just over the horizon.
The Blade has been busy - Avernus is my hunting ground now.
Critical Fail A
The Prince of Comets, Orpheus.
Nothing stands out, honestly. It's all been a flurry.
You could have a future in brewing, start your own label maybe - 'Shadowheart's Special Scrumpy'.
I can't help but feel some things have been left undone.
No need. I know you Sharrans must have so very much on your minds - better they forget where to find my family home.
*Cutting through the dreadful buzz of the wasps and the screams of the damned, a familiar, comforting voice echoed in your mind - Withers.*
My body cannot be harmed, mortal! Merely my dignity.
Breathe deeply and take in the scents around you.
Mad as a sack of shaken geese, clearly. No wonder they got rid of her.
And it looks like life at your lover's side is suiting you...
'The Hero and I,' no?
You almost sound like you want to go adventuring again...
None would dare, my love.
It was far from a sure thing - I have very high standards, when it comes to festivities.
You know best. But a little fetch never hurt anyone, as far as I know.
Your choices brought you to this moment. Accept your part in the Grand Design.
I shall be able to keep the children enthralled for a few more nights yet, thanks to you. And should you wish to retell of your exploits in person? Well, I shall not object to a night off.
Ambition drove Cazador's cruelty, made him do unspeakable things. You'd really help the likes of him?
The day I weary of those lips is the day I weary of life.
Now, now, we've had enough swapping clothes.
That's awful, I'm so sorry.
Selûne's Ire
You can't convince me you don't miss it just a little bit...
I've been healing. Learning. Finding my place in the world.
Legions of Bone
I've slain more than githyanki. Tall mouthers living in the Trollclaws, ogres roaming the Forlorn Hills...
Not that they don't look flattering on him. Almost everything does.
There are thousands of vampire spawn in the Underdark - lost souls I lured into the shadows. The least I could do was give them a place they'd be safe.
If you really want to help, you'll get Minsc out of trouble for me. Spare me that adventure.
Or should I say - Ascendant.
Enrich your story with details from the designs you found on the nautiloid.
Glad to hear it. After all we've been through, I think you deserve some time where the greatest peril you'll face is a papercut.
Always a popular choice.
Father, I love you. I'm a good spawn. A good little spawn.
And yet deserve so much more.
You sound like you need a drink.
Gale, who now names himself a god. Though in truth - Minsc has known few wizards who did not think of themselves so.
Well no, I have had a busy schedule. I've been mixing with Baldur's Gate highest society, after all. Making connections, gaining influence - finding my place in this beautiful city of yours.
I'm so grateful for the time we had together.
Your higher form has brought with it some higher manners, then.
The gnomes know Gond by his true name, Nebelun, it seems. I like it.
Dekarios the divine graces us with his presence. I hope you do not expect me to bow or utter a prayer in your honour.
A delight from the orchards of Cormyr: crisp, juicy, and ever-so-slightly tart.
Ah, diplomacy - not so different from fighting, I find. You still grip your blade, you just hide it beneath a silken glove.
Misty Step
And then of course there's your lady Mizora, to make a Council of Five.
An alliance? Do you think the Gith might again unite under one sky?
Wizard, Formerly of Waterdeep
Please tell me you've seen sense.
So long as your ambitions serve to help mortals, and not harm them, I'm happy for you.
Interesting. If the chance should arise for you to thwart Shar in some way, assume you have my support.
Milil
I'm glad you came. It has been too long.
I suppose you may.
The potent scent of ripe tomatoes on the brink of rot wafts from this stuffed crate.
Between you and me, I've pretended to have a sprained ankle now and again, for a ride on those muscles.
Fireball
Such is my way, for better or for worse.
She saved me from myself...
Tear at your chest cavity.
It was as if a thousand skeletons were walking the skies and had split into pieces. Skulls, knuckles, ribs rained down on me.
Presentable? I'm covered in hell-gore.
*The red dragon appears, poised to carry you into the skies. You will fight for githyanki liberation as a Warrior of the Comet.*
I didn't ask earlier - what were you doing in the Fugue Plane?
Give it a little while - and your fears will be long forgotten.
Your caution is warranted, but believe me - I know enough of divination to promise you our future is one worth looking forward to.
War Cleric
I've missed you, girl. Like, I've really missed you. My old friend Shadowheart.
Resist the craving.
Great Old One Warlock
And I've been telling them about you of course - how brave and selfless you were, joining Lae'zel. That, and a lot more besides; you're my favourite topic.
How right you are, old friend. I never pictured a life surrounded by devils, both friend and foe.
I will miss our time together. But then again, maybe this isn't goodbye so much as it's...
You might as well ask if the stars will ever snuff out, or Avernus freeze over. A consideration for the far future.
*But whenever he looks into your eyes, or up at the stars while he sits by your side, you know the answer.*
I just want more time with you. I miss you.
Turns out she's kept me on a loose leash.
*You are the one villain the hero could not bring himself to kill.*
Opportune Predator
You look good, with your sleeves rolled up, working in the garden. I had to remind myself I was there to transplant the red cabbages and not just enjoy the view.
I don't suppose you'd consider fleeing the Hells and joining us there to slay every last sarth and kith'rak.
Waving: Friendly
I've been getting acquainted with the length and breadth of Faerûn - there's a lot to see, now that I'm free from Shar.
Come here. I want another hug.
Waving: Leaning
She acts as such. I'll never be rid of her.
I've never felt magic more powerful. Focus the undead!
I mean to slay every last sarth and kith'rak. And I mean for the Blade of Frontiers to join me.
I did what felt right. Did you, when you chose to become the 'Vampire Ascendant'?
Honestly? I've been missing all of you, mostly.
Everything we fought for, everything we survived... only for you to succumb to madness right as we prevail...? Oak Father forgive us...
You can't be dead! You promised you'd take me to the heavens with you!
When attacked, the Owlbear can call for help.
Of course I'll have him - if he wants to come with me, that is. I'd have offered sooner, but everything was a blur after the battle - I thought he'd gone to roam free...
Good - to challenge Mystra would have been a greater folly even than Karsus's.
Embroidered with pure silver, this garment fits the body like a glove, while allowing complete ease of movement.
There must be a downside.
Discipline. Focus. The art of unarmed combat. All things that would benefit a wizard in their studies. It would be an honour.
You managed to drag me to the only bookshop in Avernus, Gale. I think they'll believe that.
It is as she wished. It is as all githyanki wish.
Song of Defence: 5
Writhing Current
If Vlaakith claimed her, it was Lae'zel's honour to be claimed.
Player already invited or in lobby.
*... or so it would have been, had you not indulged too often in the power that the illithids provided. Now the scales demand to be balanced. Ceremorphosis beckons...*
| Select Path |
More to the point - I missed you.
Exactly! Her heart would be cured! When this day comes, you must come and bunk with Minsc and Boo.
*And you are building an army of your own - the outcasts, the exiles and the rebels flock to your cause.*
Redirected Attack
It's more responsibility than I was ready for.
Four months of age at most - a mote of love in its purest form. She is perfection.
Interesting. If the chance should arise for you to thwart Shar in some way, assume you have my support.
I think he'll make an excellent addition to the pantheon.
Gale's friend Tara, right? It's good to see you again.
Shadow Monk
No Jaw attachment
It's strange to say it, but I've never been happier. This unexpected life of mine has turned out to be quite wonderful.
I have been dabbling with the idea of capturing our adventures with humble ink and parchment.
Any who survive the torments of the gods deserve peace. Most never find it.
There's special potions that can help with that - I think I saw some on a table over yonder if you care to investigate.
Mind if I play along with you?
Trying to escape bad memories?
I've thought about you, though. How could I not? My sweet, wicked darling.
You've felled enough cambions to build a fortress with their horns.
O! That I could touch you in flesh, run my hands across your skin.
Asking: Approach
The Vampire Ascendant ruling the world? That's an ambition worthy of my patronage...
'Valour is found not in the wounds you inflict, but in the lives that you've bettered.'
I think that particular feat was your doing, but having a wizard with an aptitude for excellently timed counterspells beside you no doubt helped.
What have you got there, Scratch?
Karlach Angry Emoji
You seem to be enjoying your new life?
I'd like you to change the song.
Winking Gale
Mizora must keep you busy with her missions, too.
Character Visibility
Red Bow Tie
Tusk - a boar, back in the grove. I had promised to help find him a mate before we embarked on our quest, but with all that transpired... I forgot.
Oh of course, all that and more. But it's your modesty that I truly admire the most...
Literally nothing. I don't know how people live without divine guidance.
*... your tale ends here. Farewell.*
Oops
Greyscale
That letter... your father went down with the Iron Throne. But maybe Mizora can still help.
Song of Defence: 4
Cladden with love, thou sundered the greater evils that attempted to rot away this realm.
He d-dangled me from the High Hall. Upside-down. For two hours.
Baldur's Gate 3
I love you, Lae'zel. To know you is an honour and a pleasure.
Ah, travelling far and wide, seeing all this world has to offer. A fine life indeed.
Civilisation is but an extension of nature. They can thrive together, if given the chance. Same as Thaniel and Oliver.
Right you are. But even tonight, beneath the Tears of Selûne, the city isn't far from my mind.
Well, our love can hardly be confined to expression in the common tongue. Not when githyanki offers so many colourful alternatives.
Next time, I'll visit properly - and without any uninvited tagalongs. You both can give me the grand tour.
I found the other spawn in the Underdark. We're building a new home down there.
*The allies who stood with you against the Absolute are gathering, and you are invited.*
I'm doing what I can. No more or less than that.
Thou deserveth as much. Let thy mind be its own place thou mayest sow and reap. Ah, what sweet fruits might such fertile ground yield?
What of you? Have you continued to drink the blood of the living?
I found the other spawn in the Underdark. We're building a new home down there.
Oh fine, if it gets you to crack a smile.
It's good to see you too, Minsc.
I hope so, but I fear it is not the case.
You've opened the gates to every and all refugees. A wise choice, do you think?
What in the - I only meant to hurt him, not incinerate him!
True. And yet I still don't trust you.
You jest, surely? I sport more tentacles than a fishmonger's window.
Who flickers there 'twixt the shadows? Gale, who didst surrender his very self for the salvation of Faerûn.
I'm not sure. Are you feeling especially weak?
Big red's the one driving 'em mad. Get him first, and be quick.
*Sigh* I suppose you are right. We have seen too much black and red these last months.
Are you still offering blessed items for sale?
Yes, yes, ever the hero. I am so very proud of you, you know. Though I'd prefer to be ashamed of you home together in Waterdeep.
You know, I miss that, actually.
Now it is out of my grasp once more. Either destroyed, or claimed by the goddess and hidden away where I cannot sense its presence.
You can certainly die trying.
*An invitation to a gathering of friends. Those allies who stood with you against the Netherbrain, those who thwarted the Grand Design.*
The Gondians made a choice. They will suffer the consequences.
To freedom. Hard-won, but worth it.
I rather think I can. Ta-ta for now.
I've been seeing the world - finally living my life on my terms.
Ansur was a myth, father. It is up to me to save Baldur's Gate from the Absolute.
Didst thou not employ her ever to carry all of thine loot?
I couldn't wish for a life more furious, more bloody, and more fitting for a gith warrior - or a battle partner as mighty as Karlach.
Ansur, the great wyrm, is a mere pile of bones. We should investigate further.
My new form has dictated that I live a quiet existence, far from prying eyes and panicky hearts.
Looking Up
Come to gloat, Mizora? We saw Ravengard's corpse for ourselves.
Some good, some bad.
I never imagined you'd leave such a mark on the city, and so quickly.
Of course I did - look at me! I have it all - power, riches, influence. What more could I want?
A thief, a liar, and a danger to anyone foolish enough to trust you.
Critical Fail B
I've had to walk a delicate path, killing devils while keeping Mizora on my side.
Summon your mate to protect you in battle.
Man, we had some good times. Wish I had more time to reminisce, but surviving Avernus is just non-stop.
Tombstone
|Level Up!|
Or... projected? Honestly, if I'd known this was an option, I would have stayed at home too.
You've found a lover, a partner. You will stay here, find your own way forward.
I can't. I've been away from my parents for far too long already.
Wings Open
Kagha sought easy answers and succumbed to zealotry. You're better than that.
Grand Duke Ravengard died when the Iron Throne was destroyed. We should talk to Mizora; maybe there's something she can do.
What's happened to your father? Did Mizora make good on her promise?
Thou art where thou must be - until thou goest where thou must go.
Quite the gathering. Rife with fascinating characters.
Hell, I don't need luck. I've got the Blade of Avernus on my side.
I've never seen you so anxious.
Have you heard word from Orpheus, by chance?
It's not for me to say - I wasn't there. But I'm here now, if you wish to talk.
Call for one of Orpheus' dragons. Vlaakith must be vanquished for good.
We killed the kuo-toa after we became their god. There are none left to aid us in the battles ahead.
Swords Bard
You swore to maintain order, to preserve the tenets of civilisation itself, and stand as a bulwark against those who sought to tear it down.
I have been both victim and monster. Whichever you saw me as, if your turned your blade on me, there are still those who would grieve my passing.
Zhak vo'n'fynh duj.
I'm just glad I'm not the only one encouraging you to leave the library once in a while. It does one good to feel the grass beneath one's paws from time to time.
A cure for your heart! Karlach, do you know what this means? Soon, your heart will be cured!
Perhaps I will, one day.
I'm just relieved no one minds the tentacles too much.
I am aware. Perhaps I put too much faith in my skills of negotiation, or want to see good where there is none.
That ranger's left a mountain of corpses in his wake and collected a tale or two. You'd indulge him one, yes?
Something's nagging at me. Could be a trap, set by the one and only Mizora.
I'm glad you could slip away to see your father. He must be so proud of you.
I agree, Tara. He's not who he used to be.
I'm just relieved no one minds the horns too much.
*Weary Jaheira. Over time, her stresses may have shrunk her hippocampus, making its taste more intense.*
I've kept my weapons sharp and my mind sharper. If there's another world-ending threat awaiting us, I'll be ready.
Yes - embrace it. Show Faerûn your power.
I assure you, I meant exactly what I said to you at the time. Perfect as they are, some things aren't made to last forever.
All right. Meet me at camp.
Proselyte of Mahkloompah
Examine Ansur's remains.
Well now I miss home. Shall we skip the festivities and head back?
Urgh, rank. I'd take 'rat' over this any day.
What a shame - I'd like to hear a different song, please.
Blooming Dead
Why don't you start at the beginning?
I am lucky to have your counsel. It was sorely needed.
Tombstone
Is that so...? And what liberties did you decide to take, exactly?
Screenshot
There will be no hunt today. You will suffer justice, by my hand.
Shra'kt'lor is the capital of the githzerai - an exiled people, once kin with mine until the madness of civil war ripped our one sky into two.
Are you joking? I've been counting down the days.
Call me 'cat' again, and see if you wake up with a trachea.
A spirit called Hope died in Avernus trying to save me.
You know, it'll be very difficult for me to keep focused on the rest of the party if you keep kissing me like that.

I write this letter with the most fervent hope that it need never be delivered. If you are reading it, then my hope was for naught. I have failed.
